description: Bounded batch of the LED-01 event-content embedding PRODUCER: walks embed-scope candidate events newest-first and embeds the ones that have no vector yet, up to batch_limit per call (1..200, default 25; clamped). Embed scope: event_type=MESSAGE AND role in {user, assistant} AND non-blank inline content_text, minus internal-thinking subtypes — Codex reasoning messages share the ASSISTANT-MESSAGE storage shape and are excluded by a Python-side content_json.subtype check (the flat state-interface filter grammar cannot reach a JSON subfield); Codex worklog narration stays in scope. Each embedded event is chunked (8192-char windows, 512-char overlap, 16-chunk bound with a loud log + events_truncated count on truncation), embedded in one batched generate_embeddings call, and stored under external_id '{event_id}:{chunk_index}' in the session_ledger_event pgvector namespace; the chunk-0 row doubles as the already-embedded discriminator (find_missing_external_ids). Idempotent under retry — a same-id delete precedes each store, and events are append-only immutable so re-chunking is deterministic. Returns {candidates_scanned, events_embedded, chunks_stored, events_skipped_existing, events_skipped_filtered, events_truncated, exhausted, batch_limit}; loop while exhausted=false to drain the backlog (operator subset backfill now; the Lane-1 scheduled drain rides the same verb later). Embedding runs synchronously inside the call — hence is_long_running and the bounded batch. is_discoverable=false: operator/maintenance surface, not model-proposed.
embedding_description: Producer maintenance verb that generates and stores vector embeddings for ledger conversation messages that do not have them yet, one bounded newest-first batch per call. Fills the per-event content embedding namespace that powers message-text semantic search, skipping already-embedded events and out-of-scope rows, and reports how many events it embedded and whether the backlog is drained.
